overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly specialized professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, focusing on computational social science, disinformation, and coordinated inauthentic behavior. With a combined following of 3,580, he achieves remarkably high engagement rates across all platforms, particularly when sharing research outputs, academic opportunities, and technical tool updates.

contentThemes.description: Research, tool updates (like CooRnet), and conferences focused on detecting and analyzing coordinated link sharing and disinformation campaigns.
Recruitment of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students for computational social science projects.
Announcements of newly published papers, research grants, and academic achievements.

recommendations: Leverage LinkedIn's larger reach to cross-promote technical tool releases (like CooRnet) that are currently only shared on Mastodon.
Capitalize on Bluesky's exceptionally high engagement rate by increasing post frequency, particularly for interactive academic discussions.
Incorporate visual elements or infographics when explaining complex methodological approaches to further boost reposts and shares.

platformInsights.bluesky: Provides the highest average engagement rate (6.14%), with users showing strong interest in publication announcements and academic recruitment.
platformInsights.mastodon: Attracts a tech-savvy, methodology-focused audience that responds well to open-source tool updates and platform governance discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Serves as the largest audience base (1,850 followers) and drives the highest absolute volume of engagements, making it ideal for formal announcements such as grants and hiring.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
